capabilities: create Excalidraw whiteboard canvases from the ribbon icon
draw with a Chinese hand-writing font by default
link canvas shapes to Obsidian notes via Obsidian URLs or [[filename]] links
use the latest Excalidraw features inside Obsidian
extras: Offers a free companion website (handraw.top) for using the same whiteboard outside Obsidian, and includes donation links.
intentEvidence: A whiteboard supporting default Chinese hand write font and multi-canvas based on Excalidraw
problem: Using Excalidraw in Obsidian with hand-drawn Chinese text requires installing a Chinese handwriting font yourself; this plugin has one built in.

relations.evidence: A Obsidian plugin of excalidraw-cn which a whiteboard supporting Chinese hand draw font by default based on Excalidraw.

summary: Excalidraw-based whiteboard plugin that ships a Chinese hand-writing font by default and links shapes to Obsidian notes.
